title: Mewtwo's Genesis
description: Adds a new item, the Berserk Gene, and a new way to revive Mewtwo from it, along with putting a use to Legendary Monuments's Tuft of Mew Hair.
body:
## Note: REQUIRES LEGENDARY MONUMENTS TO FUNCTION

### [For use privately only. For servers, EXPRESS PERMISSION FROM ME MUST BE GIVEN.]

Adds an item, the Berserk Gene, crafted with two redstone dust and a Psychic Gem. This item has no other current use but to be put in a Resurrection Machine along with Legendary Monuments's Tuft Of Mew Hair item. For those that want Mew to be obtained in order to have access to Mewtwo.
(I heavily recommend removing ATM's recipe to revive Mewtwo from a Psychic Gem and Nether Star for the full experience.)

### Future functions:
Berserk Gene will have its original function, raising attack by two stages while making a Pokemon confused (being added in 1.5)

The R substance from Detective Pikachu will be added, with 2 variants, the first variant, which will maximize the attack stats whilst keeping the confusion effect from Berserk Gene, and the second variant, which will only increase the attack stats by 3 stages, and removes the confusion effect. The methods to create these variants of R is currently undecided. These items are going to be held items, like the Berserk Gene. (being added in 1.5)

Mewtwo will also receive its "Neo Armored" form from Mewtwo Strikes Back: Evolution, with a new ability, typing, and a custom move. This form will be unlocked through the Neo M2 Bind item. (being added in 2.0)

Mewtwo's Spoon from the manga will be added, boosting Sp. Atk and Sp. Def, along with two sister items that will boost other stats. (being added in 2.5)
